> salem wrote:

>>>Scott,

>>>Bleed (a D-action) which causes all 3 Red Listed minions to burn, do I

>>
>> i'd guess 'no'.
>>
>> the bleed ousts the methuselah.
>>
>> the ousting burns the minions.
>>
>> sort of one step too far down the chain of events to trigger the
>> trophies.
>
> Correct. It is not an action to burn a minion (or minions).
> The action merely burns pool (and grabs the edge, possibly).

The action causes the minion to burn.

Logical steps
1) untapped minion bleeds a player with a redlisted vampire
2) player is ousted by bleed and all of his cards are burned
3) A freak drive may be played after the player is ousted.

A action modifier may only be played during an action.

Due the results of a D action, a redlisted vampire was burned.

The redlist rules make no distiction between whether the D-action had to be
directed at the redlisted vampire. It stated that trophies are awarded when
redlisted vampires are burned as a result of a D-Action. As you can see
from the above sequence, a trophy should be awarded.

See ruling on Path of Death and Soul.

--

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <d2hm48$rac$1...@domitilla.aioe.org>, XZealot

<x_ze...@brucefoodsla.com> writes:
>The redlist rules make no distiction between whether the D-action had to be
>directed at the redlisted vampire. It stated that trophies are awarded when
>redlisted vampires are burned as a result of a D-Action. As you can see
>from the above sequence, a trophy should be awarded.
>
> See ruling on Path of Death and Soul.

The Red List rules do not include the words "a result of". It must be
the (D) action itself that does the burning.

Rulings on Path of Death and the Soul don't apply, since that makes no
restrictions on the manner of burning.
